title: Development Manager
description: We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Development Manager to join our team in Tamil Nadu. The Development Manager will play a crucial role in recruiting and training advisors, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge to succeed in their roles. This position involves actively selling career opportunities to prospective advisors and maintaining high standards of recruitment quality through various channels, including field activities and leveraging the natural market. Key Responsibilities include: - Recruiting by effectively communicating career opportunities to potential advisors. - Ensuring that advisors receive comprehensive training on products, regulations, and sales techniques. - Monitoring and tracking the business performance of advisors to ensure targets are met. - Providing practical training by accompanying advisors to client meetings, enhancing their understanding of the sales process. - Guiding advisors through the sales funnel to achieve revenue targets and maximize customer satisfaction. - Conducting need analysis for prospective customers to ensure high levels of customer delight. - Implementing promotional activities aimed at boosting both sales and recruitment efforts. - Being accountable for revenue generation and the achievement of business targets. The ideal candidate will possess strong sales skills and a passion for mentoring others. If you are looking for an opportunity to make a significant impact in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply. Interested candidates can WhatsApp their updated resume to 9500702245 -Dharunika.This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our team in Karnataka or Tamil Nadu. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in recruiting and talent acquisition, with a proven track record of sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent across various roles. As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a crucial role in shaping our workforce and ensuring that we have the right people in place to drive our business forward. Key Responsibilities: - Collaborate with hiring managers to understand their staffing needs and develop effective recruitment strategies. - Source candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media, and networking events. - Conduct interviews and assessments to evaluate candidates' skills and cultural fit. - Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from job posting to offer negotiation and onboarding. - Maintain and update the applicant tracking system to ensure accurate records of candidate interactions. - Build and maintain relationships with potential candidates and industry professionals to create a talent pipeline. - Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in talent acquisition to continuously improve our recruitment processes. Required Skills: - Proven experience as a recruiter or talent acquisition specialist. - Strong understanding of recruitment processes and techniques. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. - Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. - Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and recruitment software. If you are passionate about connecting talent with opportunity and have the experience we are looking for, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Onsite Recruitment Coordinator (Hosur, Tamil Nadu)
description:
**Company Description**
Are you ready to accelerate your career? Join Cielo as an
**Onsite Recruitment Coordinator!**
A career at Cielo will give you the opportunity to work with the industry’s smartest people and to take ownership of your success!
  
  
Cielo is a brand that reflects our big idea – that talent is rising – and with it our opportunity to rise above. We create careers for ambitious people by moving beyond traditional assumptions of what it means to work in talent acquisition.
  
  
Cielo is the world's leading Talent Acquisition Partner. We deliver a better talent experience for everyone through Talent Acquisition, Search, Consulting, and Digital Accelerators™. With our fresh approach – we design and build comprehensive, proven solutions inspired by technology to find and keep the unique talent that elevates our clients above the competition.
  
  
Cielo is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, or any other status protected by state or local law for an individual who falls within the jurisdiction of such law. Applicants who require an accommodation throughout the application and interview process should request this in advance by contacting Cielo Talent Acquisition at talent.acquisition@cielotalent.com
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
The
**Onsite Recruitment Coordinator**
is responsible for providing client site support to the talent acquisition process lifecycle, from candidate attraction to post-hire activities. Additionally, the
**Onsite Recruitment Coordinator**
facilitates a variety of onsite logistical, relationship management, and customer service activities to service a client program or team.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Cielo Onsite Recruitment Coordinator supporting GE Vernova, you will be responsible for service excellence throughout the recruitment cycle. You will act as a brand ambassador, focusing on delivering exceptional talent while providing proactive and timely communication. This role supports high-volume production and logistics hiring within manufacturing environments.
  
  

* Work Location: Hosur, Tamil Nadu, India
* Work Setup: 3 days onsite
* Language(s): Proven ability to manage stakeholder relationships and deliver recruitment activities, with working proficiency in Gujarati and English for daily business communication
* Work Hours: Standard working hours aligned with business needs

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Cultivate and manage relationships with current and potential hiring leaders as an onsite representative.
* Manage candidate and client onsite communications and utilize client location knowledge and discretion to coordinate set-up of interview rooms, including materials distribution, and act as a recruitment contact during interview process.
* Meet and greet interviewers and candidates, including briefing candidates with a review of the role, interview format, and client details.
* Facilitate and grow professional relationships with local universities/colleges and technical programs as well as other resources to share client career paths and hiring needs.
* Assist in the creation of recruitment marketing plans specific to client location with local recruitment and candidate generation expertise.
* Act as liaison with the client to resolve daily operational issues.
* Showcase a high level of understanding and become fully engrained in the client organization including relationships with client stakeholders and organizational structure to further demonstrate “We Become You”.
* Provide professional recruitment resource for visitors, vendors, and candidates as necessary.
* Serve as a client representative through candidate attraction and engagement.
* Assist with onboarding processes, including new hire forms, new employee orientation presentations, etc., as well as offboarding processes.
* Act as a resource for client leaders, providing information and answering inquiries.
* Schedule phone, video and in-person interviews for Recruiters and Hiring Managers.
* Manage offer process, including creating and routing offer letters for approval.
* Coordinate background, drug, and reference checking processes.
* Arrange candidate travel, transportation, and accommodation.
* Edit and post positions to Applicant Tracking System (ATS) accurately and within the specified timeframe(s) with proper approval channels.
* Assist with and manage basic metrics reporting, as necessary.
* Provide other administrative support to recruiters, as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Qualifications
  
  
**Position Requirements**
**Education:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 1-2 years proven experience in high-volume blue-collar recruitment within a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

**Exposure:**

* Knowledge of commonly used concepts, practices, and procedures within talent acquisition strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite, including Outlook, required.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work in dynamic and constantly changing environment.

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
   

  

 The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling \& Staffing Support**
* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.


**Capacity, Utilization \& Workforce Analytics**
* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision\-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity\-related information as requested by management.


**Coordination \& Stakeholder Communication**
* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.


**Process \& Administrative Support**
* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2\-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.


**Core Competencies**
 Resource Coordination
   

  

 Relationship Management
   

  

 Schedule Management
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

 Capacity Planning \& Tracking
   

  

 Business Acumen
   

  

 Workforce Analytics
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Operational Support
   

  

 Attention to Detail
   

  

 Data Accuracy \& Reporting
   

  

 Adaptability
   

  

**Success Measures**
* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision\-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.
